summary: This is a routine Form 8-K relating to an amendment of an exclusive global license agreement for CannEpil between Splash Beverage Group and Argent BioPharma. The addendum expands the field of use to veterinary applications, adjusts royalty rates (10% veterinary, 15% human), and extends deadlines. No securities transactions, M&A activity, or special-situation event is involved. This is a standard business contract modification disclosed under Item 1.01, with a related press release under Item 7.01. Watch for license revenue performance or further amendments, but no risk-arb angle applies.
